preconditions.description: The length of S is at most 40.

preconditions.expression: ('@' in S and '.' in S) or (all(c.isdigit() or c in '+-() ' for c in S))
preconditions.description: S is either a valid email (contains '@' and '.') or a valid phone number (contains only digits and allowed separators).

preconditions.expression: len(S) >= 8 if '@' in S else len(S) >= 10
preconditions.description: Emails have length at least 8; phone numbers have length at least 10.

postconditions.description: The return value is a string.
The output is an email mask if and only if the input is an email.

If S is an email, the output is the first letter of the first name (lowercased), followed by 5 asterisks, followed by the last letter of the first name (lowercased), followed by '@', followed by the rest of the email (domain) in lowercase.

postconditions.expression: ('@' not in S) and (return_value == ('+' + '-' * (len(digits) - 10) + '*' * (len(digits) - 10) + '-' + '***-***-' + digits[-4:]) if len(digits) > 10 else ('***-***-' + digits[-4:]))
postconditions.description: If S is a phone number, let digits be the sequence of all digits in S. If there are more than 10 digits, the output starts with '+', followed by asterisks equal to the number of country code digits, then '-***-***-' and the last 4 digits. If there are exactly 10 digits, the output is '***-***-' followed by the last 4 digits.
